patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature sections, pairing large product mockups with concise descriptive text on alternating sides.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings create a strong visual hierarchy, contrasted with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A high-contrast palette of dark charcoal backgrounds and white text is consistently accented by a vibrant, flowing red/orange element that defines key sections.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay with white text and logo to a compact, solid white sticky bar with dark text and logo upon scrolling past the hero section.

A dynamic, full-bleed red/orange wave graphic acts as a background element in the hero, which appears to be fixed or scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Feature sections are clearly delineated by alternating full-width background colors (dark charcoal, white, red) and often include large, detailed product UI mockups.

technique_notes: The hero section incorporates a large, fluid red/orange background element, likely implemented using a canvas animation or video, which is positioned to create a sense of depth by either remaining fixed or scrolling slower than the main content as the user navigates down the page.

The main navigation bar is designed to be initially transparent, overlaying the hero content, and then transitions to a smaller, opaque white bar with a subtle shadow and inverted text/logo colors once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful sans-serif headings (approximately 3-4 times the size of body text) with strong weight contrast, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for all other content.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and input fields have a slight curve; product mockups feature rounded corners, but overall design is sharp).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but tighter spacing for lists and footer links.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, fluid, and dynamically animated red-orange wave graphic as a core background element provides a strong, energetic visual identity and a unique sense of depth and motion throughout the hero section and beyond.
